name: clickt-reporting
description: Clickt's hosted ecomm client reporting system. Scaffolds a client-agnostic report engine (tabbed monthly reports + weekly pulses: Google Ads, Meta, store/CRO, goal attainment with flexible v2 goals incl. SKU and seasonal targets) into a client repo, hosts it behind per-client basic auth at reports.clickt.ca, and runs the report cycles: pull → validate → spot-check → draft → John's commentary → deploy only after approval. Includes a weekly-Routine workflow that requests and integrates commentary. Honors profit-vs-revenue value semantics per channel (POAS vs ROAS, never blended; MER/nCAC suppressed on incomplete spend). Node ≥18; data via Windsor.ai / platform MCPs.

interface.shortDescription: Build and run approval-gated ecommerce client reports.
interface.longDescription: Set up and operate client-agnostic monthly reports and weekly pulses for paid media, store performance, CRO, and goals, with explicit data validation, commentary review, profit-aware channel semantics, and approval-gated deployment.
defaultPrompt: Set up reporting for this ecommerce client.
Run this client's monthly reporting cycle.
Prepare this week's performance pulse for review.
